clips.title: The story
paras: Krusk wants Lord Aliden Perenolde, leader of the Syndicate, dead and the Warchief's pendant recovered. His manor stands north, on the shores of Lordamere Lake, and his mistress Elysa is the one to ask about the pendant.

After Blackmoore's Legacy, Krusk says Perenolde has to die, and the world be rid of his foulness. The manor sits a way to the north, on the shores of Lordamere Lake, at Dandred's Fold. When the deed is done, you are to put your questions about Taretha's pendant, which the Warchief desires, to his mistress Elysa.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is clear that Perenolde must be killed, his foulness removed from the world. His manor lies a ways to the north of here, on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Do your duty, friend, then retrieve the pendant that the Warchief desires, and return here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: No, no please don't hurt me! I never meant your people any harm, he's had me against my will! Please... Spare me!
